scope: representation scientific sources and optional rerun boundaries; not a GPU execution interface
supported_default: saved scores/predictions/compact validation arrays; no inference

interpretation_boundaries.counterfactual_witness: aggregate corroboration only until witness logits or states plus fitted weights are available
interpretation_boundaries.controlled_full_state_and_elicitation: aggregate support; native/DIM query records present but full-state probe/elicitation predictions not a complete saved-score replay
interpretation_boundaries.retrospective: frozen position-confounded baseline invalid; positive no-position variant post hoc; frozen-plan OOF replication separate
interpretation_boundaries.source_closure: recovered scientific dependencies are source snapshots; no provider launcher, account credentials, reviewer text or optional GPU verification included

source_note: Original scientific helper package names are preserved under source/. Some runtime entry points still require original input layouts and undistributed fitted parameters/activations. No end-to-end GPU execution is certified.
